Logistic timing model of each initiation zone

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity.R
fit_timing_models.Rd

For each IZ, fit usage ~ progress by logistic regression (stats::glm.fit) on cells with finite values and report the intercept, S50 = -intercept / slope (progress at 50% usage), slope, timing_heterogeneity = 1 / (1 + |slope|) and the deviance-explained quality. Flags: always_0 / always_1, no_observations (no finite usage), fit_failed, non_converged, flat_slope, decreasing, S50_out_of_range, separation (|coefficient| > 30) and non_monotonic (a drop larger than nonmonotonic_tolerance in usage_probability).

Usage

fit_timing_models(
  usage,
  progress,
  usage_probability = NULL,
  nonmonotonic_tolerance = 0.1,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

usage

Cells x IZs usage matrix.

progress

Replication progress of the cells.

usage_probability

NULL or bins x IZs probabilities (compute_usage_heterogeneity()$probability).

nonmonotonic_tolerance

Tolerated drop between consecutive bins.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam used over IZ chunks.

Value

A data.frame, one row per IZ.
